description: Road Weight Designations is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. The Public Works Road Weight Designations dataset provides information on allowable weights for all roads owned by the Nova Scotia Department of Public Works. Coverage: Government of Nova Scotia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. Its tags are roads, weight designations, tir, road weight, road designation. It offers 13 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-04-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Nova Scotia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
